content.text: The settings test was flawed (settings are fixed within a stream, so they can't change mid-stream). Let me correct it:

arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
path='tests/cache_tests.py'
src=open(path).read()
old = '''# seed / trials / epsilon changes -> miss
for name, kw in [("seed", {"seed": 12}), ("trials", {"trials": 5}), ("epsilon", {"epsilon": 1000})]:
    events = [PATCH, {"op": "routes", "label": "p", "paths": plan()}, {"op": "repair", "id": "a"}]
    out = repair_answer(events, **kw)
    events2 = events + [{"op": "repair", "id": "b"}]
    out2 = repair_answer(events2, **kw)
    check("cache/setting " + name, out2[3]["cache_hit"], False)
'''
new = '''# repair settings are part of the identity: two repairs of the same stream
# share them, but a stream with other settings produces its own repair.
for name, kw in [("seed", {"seed": 12}), ("trials", {"trials": 5}), ("epsilon", {"epsilon": 1000})]:
    events = [PATCH, {"op": "routes", "label": "p", "paths": plan()}, {"op": "repair", "id": "a"},
              {"op": "repair", "id": "b"}]
    out = repair_answer(events, **kw)
    check("cache/setting " + name, (out[2]["cache_hit"], out[3]["cache_hit"]), (False, True))
'''
assert old in src
src = src.replace(old,new)
open(path,'w').write(src)
print('ok')
PYEOF
cd /workspace && python3 tests/cache_tests.py 2>&1 | tail -12
